intro: If you're after an easy-on-the-wallet stay in Lamphun town that's clean, new and owner-run — BaanKong Hostel (formerly Baan Kong Homestay) is one guests keep mentioning · It's a small place on Charoen Tar Road in Nai Mueang, with a still-new building, clean rooms, comfy beds and a little garden where you can sit for a quiet breakfast · What guests agree on is the cleanliness, the friendly owner, the genuinely low prices, and the bikes you can rent to explore the old town · From approx. ฿550/night · Score 8.5 on Agoda

body.html: BaanKong Hostel is a small stay in Lamphun town, on Charoen Tar Road in the Nai Mueang sub-district · It originally opened as Baan Kong Homestay before shifting to a hostel · The first thing guests mention is that the building is still new and clean — not an old house left to fade · It's an owner-run place with a quiet, friendly feel, best suited to travellers who want a clean, low-cost bed in Lamphun town rather than the facilities of a big hotel.

There are only a handful of rooms, kept simple and tidy · Many reviews say the beds are comfortable and the rooms clean and well kept · There's a restaurant and shared kitchen, free Wi-Fi, laundry service and luggage storage · A favourite detail for many is the little garden out front used for breakfast — cool, quiet mornings make it a corner guests remember · With prices starting around ฿550/night, this is one of the best-value stays in Lamphun town.
"A new, very clean place with a little garden for breakfast, a friendly owner, clean and pleasant rooms, and a very cheap price."

Another thing that earns praise is the owner and the welcome · Many reviews describe the owner as friendly and attentive, happy to suggest places to see and eat in town · The hostel also rents bikes, which suits a small town like Lamphun where you can comfortably cycle to Wat Phra That Hariphunchai, the old city walls and the temples around town · There's free parking for those driving in — a plus you won't find at many stays deep in the old town.

The location is within Lamphun town, on Charoen Tar Road — about 2 km from Wat Phra That Hariphunchai, an easy cycle or short drive away · It's around a 30-minute drive to Chiang Mai city and Chiang Mai airport, so it works as a budget base for taking Lamphun slowly, or as a stopover before heading into Chiang Mai · Being a little outside the walking-street core means it's quieter, but you trade that for driving or cycling in to the temples and markets.

To be honest, BaanKong Hostel isn't for travellers who need full facilities · It's a small place with few rooms, no pool and no hotel-style services · Some reviews suggest asking for a room set back from the road if you're worried about traffic noise, and checking your arrival time ahead since the front desk keeps limited hours rather than being staffed 24/7 · But for anyone after a clean, new bed with a caring owner at an easy price in Lamphun town, this is a sensible pick · The 8.5 score on Agoda from real reviews shows most guests are happy with what they get.

A tip from reading the reviews: let the owner know your arrival time in advance, since the front desk isn't staffed around the clock, so you won't be left waiting · If you drive, the free parking is easy to use, and it's worth asking the owner about renting a bike and the cycling routes around Wat Phra That and the old city walls — it's the most wallet-friendly way to soak up Lamphun's old-town feel.
